liveObservations.policyIds: TRANSFER_SENDER / RECEIVER / EXECUTOR / MINT_RECEIVER all point at policy 5
liveObservations.policy5Behaviour: authorizes every address probed - an armed but currently-permissive list, not ALWAYS_ALLOW

policy.priceDecimalsNote: The strike is quoted in THESE units. The live feed publishes at expo -5; the adapter normalises 5 -> 8. A strike quoted in feed-native units understates it by 1000x and the arithmetic will not complain.

feedVariants.note: Pyth publishes separate ids per session. Settling a series against the regular-session feed is what keeps a 03:00 print out of settlement - the overnight book is a different feed entirely, not a wider band on this one.

statusNote: Four contracts are deployed and hold code on Base mainnet. No canonical series exists, no settlement configuration is active, and no collateral is locked. This is a recorded deployment, not a launch.
recordedNote: Reconstructed from contracts/broadcast/Deploy.s.sol/8453/run-latest.json, which is gitignored and does not survive a clone, then re-read from chain. Before this file was written, every governance surface in the repository stated that nothing was deployed to Base mainnet.
runtimeCodeHashNote: Read from chain on 2026-09-20. The vault hash is byte-identical to the Base Sepolia vault recorded on 2026-08-25 (the vault has no constructor, so its runtime code is deployment independent). pythAdapter, factory and rfq differ from their Sepolia counterparts only because each embeds deployment-specific immutables; their runtime sizes match exactly. None of the four match a build of the current HEAD: HEAD's vault is 22035 bytes against 21553 deployed, so the vault has changed since this deployment.

deployment.scriptNote: Deploy.s.sol has no chain-id guard and reads a raw PRIVATE_KEY. The hardened variant with MAINNET_FACTORY_ADMIN, signer pinning and an admin code-length check exists only on branch feat/erodoro-product-v2 and was never merged.

admin.note: A 1-of-1 Safe over a single owner. status.md calls an EOA factory admin a mainnet blocker; this is the same single point of failure in a contract wrapper. The Safe has never executed a transaction (nonce 0).

liveFactoryState.boundsNote: The deployed minPriceLag/maxPriceLag of 1/90000 seconds is far wider than the policy recorded under `policy` in this file (600/21600). A canonical mainnet series could be created with a one-second or twenty-five-hour price window and the factory would accept it.

preflight.note: First run against the live deployed vault. TRANSFER is live, the multiplier is unity, and the vault is currently authorized under TRANSFER_SENDER/RECEIVER/EXECUTOR policy 5 - so split, merge and redeem would work today. All three policies are ARMED, meaning that authorization can be revoked by the issuer at any time.
